title: A glossary to help understand what happens in an initial public offering
title_zh: 帮助理解首次公开募股中发生的情况的术语表
summary: Anyone following SpaceX's plans to sell shares to the public is likely to hear terms thrown around that describe steps and components of an initial public offering. It is the first time a company's value will be determined by a public market.
summary_zh: 任何关注 SpaceX 向公众出售股票计划的人都可能会听到描述首次公开募股的步骤和组成部分的术语。这是公司价值首次由公开市场决定。

title: Meta signs first AI data center deal in India with Reliance
title_zh: Meta 与 Reliance 签署印度首个人工智能数据中心协议
summary: The 168-megawatt facility will support Meta's global AI computing needs and can be expanded over time.
summary_zh: 这个 168 兆瓦的设施将支持 Meta 的全球人工智能计算需求，并且可以随着时间的推移进行扩展。

title: Salesforce m3ter Deal Highlights Shift Toward Usage Based AI Revenue
title_zh: Salesforce m3ter 交易凸显转向基于使用的人工智能收入
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) announced the acquisition of m3ter, a consumption-based metering and billing platform. The company plans to integrate m3ter into Agentforce Revenue Management to support usage-based pricing for AI-focused products and services.
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）宣布收购基于消费的计量和计费平台 m3ter。该公司计划将 m3ter 集成到 Agentforce Revenue Management 中，以支持针对人工智能产品和服务的基于使用情况的定价。

title: What massive SpaceX-Alphabet compute deal means ahead of IPO
title_zh: IPO 前 SpaceX 与 Alphabet 的大规模计算交易意味着什么
summary: SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) continues to turn investors' heads ahead of its IPO this Friday, June 12, as Elon Musk's space company strikes a deal with Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) for the Big Tech company to borrow computing power for $920 million per month.
summary_zh: SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 在 6 月 12 日星期五首次公开募股 (IPO) 前继续吸引投资者的目光，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的太空公司与 Alphabet (GOOG、GOOGL) 达成协议，让这家大型科技公司每月以 9.2 亿美元的价格借用计算能力。
